title: 搶飛
mood: wanting to win one thing as an adult
subject: three phones, two laptops and a tablet queueing for concert tickets that sell out in twelve minutes
caption: Cantonese hyperpop and rave. Bitcrushed drums at double time, a pounding hardcore kick, pitched and glitched vocal fragments chopped mid-word, bright trance synth stabs, sudden silences and stutters between sections, a supersaw build into each chorus. Maximal, bitcrushed and very fast with the whole mix pushed into clipping on purpose. Female voice pitched up and sung over the chaos, sweet melody against noise, heavily processed. 170 BPM, G sharp minor. Wanting to win just one thing as an adult. No acoustic instruments, no rap verse, no ballad section, no live drums, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
十點正 三部電話 兩部電腦 一部平板
排隊人數 十八萬 我排第九萬幾
個進度條唔郁 我唔敢郁
我唔敢呼吸 我驚呼吸會斷線

[Chorus]
搶飛 搶飛
我唔係為咗睇佢 我係為咗贏一次
成年人嘅世界 我冇乜贏過
今日 我想贏呢一次

[Verse]
十點十二分 「已售罄」
三部電話 同時 出同一隻字
我坐咗喺度 冇嬲 冇喊
我開咗佢嘅歌 喺屋企 開到最大聲

[Chorus]
搶飛 搶飛
我唔係為咗睇佢 我係為咗贏一次
成年人嘅世界 我冇乜贏過
今日 我又冇贏到 但首歌仲係咁好聽

[Outro]
下一場 下個月
我已經較好鬧鐘
